Author: joenser
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8](I didn't know the foreign language well, so I used a translator. Thank you for your understanding!)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]If you want wallpaper and flooring like the sample photos, apply the PNG files in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857]rustic country walls and floors mod.[/url][/b][/color]

[b]It's Unofficial Update![/b]
[b]Distribution may be suspended at Dustbeauty's request.[/b]

[color=#D4D4D8]This is a patch of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6005?tab=description]DustBeauty's Seasonal Garden Farmhouse mod[/url], updated to be compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.
Since the farmhouse map was changed in Stardew Valley 1.6, the Farmhouse2 map no longer worked properly. That's why I created this patch. As far as I know, this patch works without any issues in Stardew Valley 1.6. I also fixed the issue where windows would appear in front of furniture.
Here are the issues I fixed:[/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The crib was not aligned with its position in Stardew Valley 1.6. (= Causing two cribs to appear.)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]After getting married, the spouse's room would appear in an unintended location. (= Nothing would appear where the spouse's room was supposed to be.)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The rooftop could not be implemented because TMXL was difficult to use.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Windows were appearing in front of furniture.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Spouses and babies could walk over windows that were supposed to show the scenery outside.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]I used the files included in DustBeauty's mod as map tiles for this patch.
I asked for permission to upload this patch, but since she hasn't responded for over a month, I am posting this file in accordance with Rule 4 (please refer to her profile for details).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Most features, such as the warp function, kitchen cooking ui, and bathroom functions, remain exactly as they are in the original. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I only added the directional signposts, Farmhouse1, and Farmhouse2. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I added directional messages to the rooftop signs and implemented i18n (internationalization).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Feel free to translate it into any language you prefer. (This feature was added in the 1.6 update, so you're welcome to use it freely.)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Since I couldn't find any errors(Texture issues, error logs, and things like that) during testing, I am uploading this file.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Among the home modification features provided by Robin, only the crib modification is available. (Using other features she provides will cause a texture error.)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]This is the re-texture and mod I'm using:[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8](Since Naver is a Korean site, you may need a VPN or a Naver account to use it)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]If possible, I recommend converting the XNB files to PNG first, then merging them with whatever you need. (To put it another way, you add the retexture layer on top of the original, un-retextured image, then erase the parts of the original image that haven't been retextured.)[/color]

[b]Options[/b]
The main file contains only cp. If you want the PIF, please download the PIF file from the options.

issuefix: If you are experiencing cellar disappearing from the cp file, enable the issuefix option. This is an option to create a cellar entrance in farmhouse2 (after the crib add version).

cabin enable: If you don't want it to apply to the cabin, disable the cabin option.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] ( Use Content Patcher mods that are compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.6 or later.) or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537?tab=description]PIF - Personal Rooms at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url][/color]
If you want to use the option's pif instead of the cp command, just download the pif.
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Download this mod(DustBeauty's Seasonal Garden Farmhouse 1.6)[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Extract all downloaded files and place the resulting folder into Mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]If you are a android user, extract the files, then compress them once and extract them again. Otherwise, there will be issues with the mod not being applied properly[/b]. (Otherwise, the assets folder, i18n folder, content.json file, and manifest.json file will be outside the mod folder)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]4.  If you are using the retexture, replace the files included in this mod (outdoorTiles, Farmhouse, etc.) with the corresponding retexture files.[b] It must be a merged file. Otherwise, a specific tile changes to a blank. Since soil and grass, trees, bushes, objects, and a large bridge(That bridge to the right of Robin's woodworking shop) are used in the rooftop file, this is essential.[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Content Patcher(Just use the Content Patcher for Stardew Valley version 1.6 or higher)
